title: BONES IN THE FLAME // JON SNOW RISES
narrative: Melisandre washes the dried crimson from Jon Snow's thirteen stab wounds at Castle Black. In the fire brazier, she casts hair and drops of kingsblood. 'Lord of Light, cast your light upon us! Arise, Jon Snow!' Ghost leaps onto the funeral bier with a savage shriek. Jon's lungs gasp for icy air; his gray eyes snap open, burning with ancient Stark frost.
resolvesPlotHole: Jon Snow's Resurrection in the Books

Ghost says no: Jon Snow refuses human resurrection because Ghost gets free belly rubs and zero paperwork.
